devtools.title: Debug Tools
devtools.description: List of tools for debugging the application. Primarily intended for developers.

playerSettings.title: Playback Settings
playerSettings.description: In this section, you can configure torrent playback and other playback settings.

torrents.title: Torrents
torrents.description1: You can connect torrents, which will automatically be linked to release episodes and available for viewing.
torrents.description2: Torrents do not require a third-party player or client and are available online in the release playback quality selection menu.
torrents.warning: Using torrents requires more connection and parsing time, which can negatively affect data loading speed for releases, especially when using a proxy server.

autoplay.description: After an episode ends, the player will automatically start playing the next episode in the release, if available.

buffer.title: Video Buffer Size
buffer.descriptionDefault: Video preload buffer size, default is 5 minutes.
buffer.label: Buffer size in seconds
buffer.descriptionHint: Specifies the buffer size that the player keeps in memory and preloads video during viewing.

autoSkipOpening.description: If opening skip markers are available, it will be skipped automatically.

skipButton.description1: An additional button will appear in the player interface that will fast forward the player by the specified number of seconds.
skipButton.description2: This button does not guarantee correct opening skipping.

skipTime.description: You can specify how many seconds to skip for the opening.
skipTime.label: Number of seconds to skip opening

create.title: Create Snapshot
create.confirmText: Are you sure you want to create a snapshot?

remove.confirmText: Are you sure you want to delete the snapshot?

restore.confirmText: Are you sure you want to restore data from the snapshot? This action cannot be undone, current data will be replaced with data from the snapshot.

consent.dataTransferConsent: Consent is required to transfer data (session identifier) to a third-party server to work with snapshots.
consent.passwordDisclaimer: Account password is not disclosed or transferred in any form

systemSettings.title: Application Settings
systemSettings.description: In this section, you can configure automatic release updates, system notifications, and other application parameters.
systemSettings.moveControlButtonsRight: Move control buttons to the right
systemSettings.moveControlButtonsRightDescription: Moves window control buttons (minimize, close, maximize) to the right.
systemSettings.filterNotificationsByFavoritesDescriptio: Enables notifications only for releases in your favorites.
systemSettings.proxyDescription1: Proxy for connecting to static and API servers. HTTP and HTTPS are supported.
systemSettings.proxyDescription2RestartNote: After changing the access point, it is recommended to restart the application.
systemSettings.endpointDescription1: You can use the main domain if it is not blocked by your provider, or use additional domains.
systemSettings.endpointDescription2: You can enter your own API and static server endpoint in the respective fields.
systemSettings.endpointRestartNote: After changing the access point, it is recommended to restart the application.
systemSettings.discordRichPresenceDescription: The application will display information about the currently viewed release in Discord Rich Presence.
systemSettings.showSystemNotificationsDescription: If the application detects an updated release when loading the latest releases, it will show a system notification about the new episode.
systemSettings.autoUpdateReleasesDescription: The application will update the latest releases in the background, even if it is minimized.
systemSettings.updateIntervalDescription: You can specify how often the application will update releases in the background.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.description: You can create backups of application data linked to your Anilibria account.

exitDialog.title: Exit
exitDialog.confirmText: Are you sure you want to exit the application?

cacheDialog.title: Application Cache
cacheDialog.confirmText: Are you sure you want to reset the cache and application settings?

actionsSettings.title: System Commands
actionsSettings.description: Some useful commands for managing the application.

sections.sortSubtitle: You can sort the list of releases by popularity or newness.

catalogView.title: Release Catalog
catalogView.subtitle: You can select genres and years for a more refined list of releases.

favoritesAuth.description2: To view, you need to log in to the application.
